Draw a 3-storey wireframe of a 20 m by 12 m building in the architectural workspace: three storeys of 3200 mm with slabs and a hip roof on top. Use the existing ground level as the base. Then tell me how many levels and walls the design has.

(()=>{const w=document.querySelector('.architect-workspace');const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(w.dataset.designId)));if(d.levels.length!==3)throw Error('Expected 3 levels, got '+d.levels.length);if(d.walls.length!==12)throw Error('Expected 12 walls, got '+d.walls.length);if(d.roofs.length!==1)throw Error('Expected 1 roof, got '+d.roofs.length);const xs=d.walls.flatMap(x=>[x.a[0],x.b[0]]),ys=d.walls.flatMap(x=>[x.a[1],x.b[1]]);return {designRevision:d.revision,levels:d.levels.map(l=>[l.name,l.elevation,l.height]),walls:d.walls.length,slabs:d.slabs.length,roofs:d.roofs.length,extentMm:[Math.max(...xs)-Math.min(...xs),Math.max(...ys)-Math.min(...ys)],uiRevision:w.dataset.designRevision}})()
